newsitem.title: SIERRA LEONE: Nigerian troops said to hold Sierra Leone airport.
newsitem.headline: Nigerian troops said to hold Sierra Leone airport.

text.p: Nigerian troops intervening in Sierra Leone after a military coup took control of the international airport at Lungi north of the capital on Monday, a Nigerian commander said.
Nigerian troops were already stationed at the airport under regional accords to protect it from rebel attacks, and since the coup it had been under uneasy joint control.
"We took it this morning. There was a firefight with the Sierra Leonean forces there but it didn't last long at all," the commander told Reuters.

He said the Nigerians and their West African allies would now start to use the airport to bring in rapid reinforcements for their intervention, as well as the smaller Hastings airport on the eastern outskirts of Freetown near the Nigerian base.
Nigerian boats began bombarding Freetown at daybreak after negotiations with the leaders of the May 25 coup ran into trouble.
